reasoning: This is a Kubernetes controller written in Go with sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime. It defines its own CRDs: api/aigateway/v1alpha1 and api/inference/v1alpha1, with CRD manifests in config/crd. Its manager binary is in cmd/manager. It reconciles ExternalModel and ExternalProvider custom resources and watches MaasTenantConfig. From these it renders and SSA-applies a per-tenant copy of the praxis-extproc dataplane manifests, plus Istio DestinationRules/EnvoyFilters and credential projections, and cleans them up through finalizers. ai-gateway-operator deploys it as a sibling of maas-controller. It is not branded as an 'operator', but its reconcile-loop pattern over CRDs that installs and manages dataplane workloads fits the operator classification.
